sourceLimits: The exact current HEROES_DB selected V2 original-project portrait is the sole internal identity authority; no external franchise reference is claimed.

Only one front three-quarter view is available. Hidden reverse headset construction, rear coat attachments, tiny gear teeth and internal cannon mechanism remain uncertain; no absolute1:1 is certified.
The source depicts a youthful character with undocumented chronological age. All scenes remain family-safe, modest, nonromantic; no invented adult age or sexual framing.
Meridian Clockwork settings are original compatible brass/bronze clockwork-city compositions, not official screenshots.
Old selected atlas actually opened: navy coat, unarmed hands, missing rust coat/blue scarf/right cannon/left gear orb and asymmetric headset; it remains historical art only.
CG05 is Nexus gameplay adaptation; CG09-11 FanArt; CG12-15 WhatIf. The futureExperienced version is explicitly hypothetical, not a new canon age.

Source knee asymmetry clarified from the SAME selected portrait: anatomical LEFT has one large frontal round brass gear disc. Anatomical RIGHT may retain the smaller PARTIAL lateral bronze protector visible at that angle, alongside dark cloth/blue wrap; it must not gain a second large centered frontal gear disc. A crop of this same bitmap is not an additional identity authority.
